purpose: Ledger of GPR backfill slices already SCANNED + INSERTED + PAID FOR into the owned table. Before ANY Phase A INSERT, check here: never re-scan a slice whose end-date is <= immutable_through. Append-only — never delete or overwrite a closed segment.
never_rebuy_rule: If a slice's end-date <= immutable_through, that date range is closed. Read from BigQuery qgi_gdelt.gkg_gpr_flags or the S3 Parquet exports. Raw GKG (gdelt-bq.gdeltv2.gkg_partitioned) is paid and touched ONLY for date ranges strictly after immutable_through.
recovery_note: S3 as durable asset, BQ as rebuildable cache. If the owned BQ table is lost or corrupted: (1) re-CREATE the table using gpr_rollup.py --phase A --print-sql (free, no scan); (2) load from the S3 Parquet exports under s3_export_prefix using bq load --source_format=PARQUET — zero BigQuery scan bytes, no re-buy. The segments_compiled ledger maps each slice to its S3 Parquet key so recovery can be targeted (load only the needed slice). Never re-scan raw GKG to recover data already in S3.
